Summary: US-3.9 Tier 0 — Diagnostic-only actions on F-4 clamp
Description: When the F-4 confidence clamp fires (surface-only / data_starved / templated actions), strip suggested_actions and emit read-only diagnostic verbs in a NEW decision.diagnostic_steps field instead. Updates LLMDecision schema, email template (notifier.py), dashboard renderer, and /decisions API. Diagnostic verbs are alert-aware: spring-boot alerts get hikari/JVM PromQL pivots; kong alerts get upstream-vs-proxy PromQL; all include a Jaeger drill link and explicit 'do NOT run kubectl rollout/scale/set' warning. Validation: replay decision 0b215ef3-74fa-4e1f-88a4-057437f04d0e through the patched pipeline — assert confidence=0.40, suggested_actions=[], diagnostic_steps[0].startswith('Open Jaeger'), no kubectl substring anywhere.

Bug surfaced during 0b215ef3 incident analysis: HighKongP95Latency matched the OOMKill action template (suggested_actions.yaml lines 67-68 emit kubectl set resources --limits=memory + kubectl rollout restart). Investigate app/action_templates.py and app/suggested_actions.yaml to find the keying bug (likely a wildcard/fallback match firing for an alert that should have no template). Fix should add a unit test asserting HighKongP95Latency and HighP95Latency do NOT return any kubectl set resources / kubectl rollout restart actions from the template lookup.

Summary: US-3.11 Tier 2 — Hypothesis-menu validator + cause-evidence rule
Description: Add _HYPOTHESIS_MENU_PATTERNS to app/response_validator.py to flag prose listing alternatives without committing ('possibly X or Y', 'either A or B', 'may be due to', 'could be one of'). Add cause-must-share-token-with-evidence rule: tokenize the RCA's first sentence (4+ char words), tokenize decision.evidence, fail if intersection minus stopwords is empty. Both rules ship aggressive behind feature flag triage_hypothesis_menu_strict (default True), with a new Prometheus metric triage_validator_retries_total{reason} so we can dial back if FP rate exceeds 5%. Hits trigger the existing retry path; backstop is the Tier 0 clamp (US-3.9).

Summary: US-3.16 MCP integrity — CI lint forbidding direct data access
Description: Add a CI check (ruff custom rule, semgrep pattern, or grep-based pre-commit) that forbids httpx/requests/aiosqlite/raw-SQL calls outside the allowed boundaries. Exempt boundary: lifespan/startup/migration code (app/main.py:lifespan, app/rca_store.py:_init_schema, drain3 boot restore in US-3.6). All other modules must route via MCP. Add to GitHub Actions workflow. Document the rule in monitoring-docs/architectural-invariants.md as a durable architectural constraint.
